FAQ

A few things
worth knowing.

Does JobsAI apply for jobs on my behalf?+

No. JobsAI prepares documents from your profile and hands you over to the employer’s official application. You review and submit. The planned daily limit is 10 tailored applications.

What does “pay only after it passes” mean?+

For done-for-you jobs, you see the plan and checks before funding escrow. JobsAI is paid after your acceptance, or auto-acceptance at the end of the 72-hour review window. Failed checks and disputes follow the refund or redo process. Career Pass is a subscription with a full refund within 14 days of the first payment, then refunds for unused full months. Application-pack documents pass checks before a credit counts; unused credits are refundable.

What if I disagree with the result?+

The planned process lets you reject during the review window. A disagreement goes to a reviewer chosen and paid by JobsAI, with a flat fee whatever they decide. They are not independent of JobsAI. The decision deadline is 72 hours. If no decision arrives in time, the funds are refunded. Disputes are reviewed by the JobsAI team through the job API.

Can JobsAI guarantee an interview or a job?+

No. It is designed to help with applications and preparation. Employers decide who to interview and hire. The fact lock can also miss subtle overstatements, so your own review matters.

How will my information be handled?+

The specification calls for profiles, documents, applications, and interview notes encrypted to your key. Model processors and their retention terms must be listed; names and contact details are stripped before review. Job inputs and outputs are deleted 30 days after settlement, and voice sessions after feedback. Losing all passkeys and recovery methods means losing access to your profile, so export is planned. Career tools currently use local example data and do not upload a CV.

What can I use now?+

Yes. The Work Tasks panel shows funded jobs and supports wallet-based claims. Career accounts, employer feeds, AI generation, and application payments are rolling out. Job creation, funding, submissions, revisions, acceptance, and disputes are supported through the JobsAI API.
